name: @bonfyre/tailwind-estate
description: Pinned PostCSS and Tailwind toolchain for estate styles

scripts.build: bun install --silent && ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ./input.pcss -o ../../site/matrix/tailwind.css --minify && for name in account-inbox pack-setup pack-presentation page-components reading-surface native-experience aurekai-bar composition blog profile-journal aurekai-native matrix world aurekai-site-program aurekai-composed matrix-aperture own-site aurekai-field-guide aurekai-research aurekai-trust front-brand; do BONFYRE_STYLE_LAYER=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ./styles/$name.pcss -o ../../site/matrix/$name.css --minify || exit 1; done && for name in aurekai-field-guide aurekai-research; do cp ../../site/matrix/$name.css ../../site/assets/$name.css || exit 1; done && for name in account-choices aurekai-activity aurekai-model campaign-workspace connection-studio program-workspace publication-research retained-material shipment-workspace source-desk source-library source-publication web-workbench extension/contents-workspace extension/cycle-reschedule extension/foreign-sign-in extension/program-editor extension/workbench; do BONFYRE_STYLE_LAYER=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ../../integrations/browser/$name.pcss -o ../../integrations/browser/$name.css --minify || exit 1; done && for name in account-navigation application-previews authoring/authoring catalogue creator document-workspace instruments/linked-workspace looks/aurekai looks/editorial looks/night opportunity-desk plan-network planner pricing-desk process-sim room-procurement schema-lab shipment-check synthesis training-creator training-workspace workbook-presentation; do BONFYRE_STYLE_LAYER=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/$name.pcss -o ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/$name.css --minify || exit 1; done && cp ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/application-previews.css ../../site/assets/application-previews.css && cp ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/account-navigation.css ../../site/assets/account-navigation.css && cp ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/instruments/linked-workspace.css ../../site/instruments/linked-workspace.css && cp ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/authoring/authoring.css ../../site/matrix/authoring-shell.css
scripts.check: bun install --silent && ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ./input.pcss -o /tmp/bonfyre-tailwind-check.css --minify && cmp -s /tmp/bonfyre-tailwind-check.css ../../site/matrix/tailwind.css && for name in account-inbox pack-setup pack-presentation page-components reading-surface native-experience aurekai-bar composition blog profile-journal aurekai-native matrix world aurekai-site-program aurekai-composed matrix-aperture own-site aurekai-field-guide aurekai-research aurekai-trust front-brand; do BONFYRE_STYLE_LAYER=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ./styles/$name.pcss -o /tmp/bonfyre-$name-check.css --minify && cmp -s /tmp/bonfyre-$name-check.css ../../site/matrix/$name.css || exit 1; done && for name in aurekai-field-guide aurekai-research; do cmp -s ../../site/matrix/$name.css ../../site/assets/$name.css || exit 1; done && for name in account-choices aurekai-activity aurekai-model campaign-workspace connection-studio program-workspace publication-research retained-material shipment-workspace source-desk source-library source-publication web-workbench extension/contents-workspace extension/cycle-reschedule extension/foreign-sign-in extension/program-editor extension/workbench; do BONFYRE_STYLE_LAYER=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ../../integrations/browser/$name.pcss -o /tmp/bonfyre-browser-${name##*/}-check.css --minify && cmp -s /tmp/bonfyre-browser-${name##*/}-check.css ../../integrations/browser/$name.css || exit 1; done && for name in account-navigation application-previews authoring/authoring catalogue creator document-workspace instruments/linked-workspace looks/aurekai looks/editorial looks/night opportunity-desk plan-network planner pricing-desk process-sim room-procurement schema-lab shipment-check synthesis training-creator training-workspace workbook-presentation; do BONFYRE_STYLE_LAYER=1 ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss --postcss postcss.config.cjs -i ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/$name.pcss -o /tmp/bonfyre-service-${name##*/}-check.css --minify && cmp -s /tmp/bonfyre-service-${name##*/}-check.css ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/$name.css || exit 1; done && cmp -s ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/application-previews.css ../../site/assets/application-previews.css && cmp -s ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/account-navigation.css ../../site/assets/account-navigation.css && cmp -s ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/instruments/linked-workspace.css ../../site/instruments/linked-workspace.css && cmp -s ../../components/BonfyreServiceSite/authoring/authoring.css ../../site/matrix/authoring-shell.css
